title: Kissing
summary: Kissing is touching someone with your lips to show affection, love or desire. It ranges from a quick peck on the cheek to slow, deep romantic kissing.
key_points: Meaning depends on context: greeting, family affection, romance or desire.
Good kissing is mostly about being relaxed, reading your partner and not rushing.
Fresh breath and soft lips help; asking 'can I kiss you?' is welcome.
steps: Make sure the other person wants it (eye contact, leaning in, or simply ask)
Start soft and slow with closed lips
Follow your partner's pace; deepen only if they respond
answer_guidance: Explain simply first, in the user's language. Mention affection/romance context. If they ask 'how', answer educationally and note mutual comfort. Don't force flirting.
